description: Dataset with the shares of electricity production per energy carrier for the large and medium producers of the paper "The rise and stall of world electricity efficiency:1900–2017, results and insights for the renewables transition", published by Pinto, Ricardo; Teives Henriques, Sofia; Brockway, Paul; Heun, Matthew; Sousa, Tania, provides historical electricity-production shares by carrier for large and medium producers used in an efficiency study. Coverage: Selected large and medium electricity producers during 1900-1970; the associated paper title extends further than this deposit. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-sa-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: The release metadata does not establish independent reuse, maintenance, complete observation coverage or tested compatibility. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
